## Teaching Assistant

**PLACEHOLDER: Course title** — PLACEHOLDER: Department, Institution \
PLACEHOLDER: term and year (e.g., Spring 2026) \
PLACEHOLDER: instructor of record

Responsibilities:

- **Review of instructional materials covering introductory statistical theory.**
  Read through lecture notes, problem sets, and solutions before release,
  checking derivations, notation, and worked examples for correctness and
  internal consistency across the course. PLACEHOLDER: name the specific topics
  covered (e.g., probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing,
  linear regression).

- **Responses to students' questions and clarification of statistical concepts.**
  Answered questions in office hours and on the course forum, working through the
  reasoning behind results rather than only the final answers, and identifying
  recurring points of confusion to report back to the instructor.
  PLACEHOLDER: note the format (in person, online, or both) and approximate
  class size.

- PLACEHOLDER: any additional duties (e.g., grading, running review sessions,
  preparing supplementary examples, holding exam preparation sessions).

## Teaching interests

PLACEHOLDER: courses you would be prepared to assist with or teach in a PhD

## Teaching philosophy

PLACEHOLDER: two or three sentences. A useful frame for a statistics course is
what you want students to be able to do independently — for instance, decide
which assumptions a method actually requires, and recognize when a result should
not be trusted — and how your teaching is organized around that.
